channel.title: The Grant Desk - Grants, Media Arts, Film & Sound, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Grants, Media Arts, Film & Sound, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: 9 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Dorothy Antoinette LaSelle Travel Fellowship 2026
    https://www.lasellefoundation.org/travel-fellowship
    Dorothy Antoinette LaSelle Foundation · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · Two awards of USD 5,000 each, distributed in the fall of 2026, to fund a research trip that furthers the artist's practice. No application fee.
  • Epic MegaGrants 2026 (Cycle 2)
    https://www.unrealengine.com/megagrants
    Epic Games · deadline Closed 04 Sep 2026 · Typical grants range from USD 5,000 to USD 75,000, with some exceptional projects receiving up to USD 150,000. Epic states that recipients continue to own their IP and may publish it however they wish, so this is a grant rather than an investment or equity deal. Grants up to and including USD 25,000 may be paid in a single instalment; larger grants are paid across several instalments tied to continued progress. Funds are for project and team expenses such as development and hiring; hardware purchases or rentals are approved only occasionally, case by case. No application fee.
  • EMAP / EMARE: European Media Art Platform Residencies 2027
    https://emare.eu/
    European Media Art Platform (EMAP / EMARE) · deadline 06 Nov 2026 · EUR 4,000 grant for the applying artist (including subsistence); EUR 2,000 for a collaborating artist (EUR 6,000 total for a duo); EUR 4,000 project budget; accommodation provided by the host; travel covered per EU ceilings; access to technical facilities and media labs. No application fee.
  • Mondriaan Fund: Acquisitions (rolling)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/acquisitions/
    Mondriaan Fund · deadline Rolling / undated · Maximum 40% of the estimated acquisition value, determined per application from the budget. The estimated value of the object must exceed EUR 50,000, and the applicant must contribute significantly to the acquisition costs. Applications requesting over EUR 500,000 are referred to the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science. No application fee.
  • Mondriaan Fund: Art Fair International (rolling)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/art-fair-international/
    Mondriaan Fund · deadline Rolling / undated · GALLERIES: where 40 to 80% of presented works are by artists from the Netherlands and/or the Caribbean part of the Kingdom, 50% of the basic stand rental, capped between EUR 4,750 and EUR 9,000 depending on rental cost; where over 80%, 80% of the basic rental, with the same caps. PUBLISHERS: EUR 1,000 where 25 to 50% of publications concern relevant contemporary art, EUR 2,000 where over 50%. Maximum one application per fair per calendar year and no more than three awards annually. No application fee.
  • Mondriaan Fund: Artist's Fee (rolling)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/artists-fee/
    Mondriaan Fund · deadline Rolling / undated · Determined per application: up to 50% of the standard amount excluding VAT, where the fee paid meets at least 100% of the guideline. Minimum application EUR 100. The fee must comply with the Fair Pay Rate Table 2023. No application fee.
  • Mondriaan Fund: Art Heritage Festival (rolling)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/art-heritage-festival/
    Mondriaan Fund · deadline Rolling / undated · Up to 40% of eligible project costs directly tied to visual art and heritage activities. The project budget must exceed EUR 25,000. Grants of EUR 100,000 or more are highly exceptional and require contacting the fund first. No application fee.
  • Mondriaan Fund: Art Heritage Presentation (rolling)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/art-heritage-presentation/
    Mondriaan Fund · deadline Rolling / undated · Up to 40% of variable project costs. The project budget must exceed EUR 25,000. Contributions of EUR 100,000 or more require contacting the fund directly. No application fee.
  • Mondriaan Fund: Collection Mobility (rolling)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/collection-mobility/
    Mondriaan Fund · deadline Rolling / undated · Determined per application; the Mondriaan Fund finances up to 40% of eligible costs. Applicants must contribute significant funding themselves. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 9 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Youth Music: Trailblazer Fund (Round 13)
    https://www.youthmusic.org.uk/funding/i-need-funding/trailblazer-fund
    Youth Music · deadline Closed 28 Aug 2026 · GBP 2,000 to GBP 30,000 for organisations in England. No application fee.
  • Arts Council England: Music Growth Fund, GBP 1,000-40,000 strand
    https://www.artscouncil.org.uk/music-growth-package/music-growth-fund-general-guidance
    Arts Council England · deadline Closed 03 Sep 2026 · GBP 1,000 to GBP 40,000, from a total annual budget of GBP 3,000,000 for this strand in 2026/27. You must find at least 25 percent of the total project budget as CASH match funding. No application fee.
  • Mondriaan Fund: Voucher Art Event, Mexico Art Week 2027
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/voucher-art-event-mexico-art-week-2027/
    Mondriaan Fund · deadline 10 Sep 2026 · A voucher covering admission to the Zona Maco preview days, a curated programme during Mexico Art Week 2027, a networking event with the Dutch Embassy, and hotel accommodation from 2 to 7 February 2027, plus a EUR 1,300 contribution towards travel costs. 15 vouchers are available. No application fee.
  • Mondriaan Fund: International Collaborative Projects with Heritage Institutes (September 2026 round)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/international-collaborative-projects-with-heritage-institutes/
    Mondriaan Fund · deadline 10 Sep 2026 · Determined per application. Up to 40% of variable project costs. For a development research phase, up to 70% of variable costs capped at EUR 15,000, covering travel, accommodation and presentation costs. The applicant must contribute significantly to the project financing, and the international partners' cost share must be proportional to the Mondriaan Fund grant. No application fee.
  • Mondriaan Fund: Heritage Innovation (September 2026 round)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/en/apply-for-a-grant/grants/heritage-innovation/
    Mondriaan Fund · deadline 17 Sep 2026 · Projects: up to 40% of variable project-related costs, with a minimum project budget of EUR 25,000. Research tracks: up to 70% of costs, capped at EUR 15,000, with no minimum budget. No application fee.
  • Trust me, I'm an AI/rtist: Open Call for Creative Interventions
    https://waag.org/en/article/open-call-creative-interventions-trust-me-im-airtist/
    Waag Futurelab (Horizon Europe project HAMLET) · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · EUR 20,000 commission fee excluding VAT, inclusive of artist fee, travel, accommodation and production costs. Applicants must have a VAT number in Europe. No application fee.
  • Musikfonds: Outer Ear Special Programme (Round 2026/2)
    https://www.musikfonds.de/foerderprogramme/
    musikfonds e.V. · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · FLAG, UNVERIFIED: per-project amounts are not published on the programme overview page and must be confirmed via the application portal at musikfonds-antrag.de. No application fee indicated.
  • British Council Travel Grant Fund (film and XR, rolling)
    https://film.britishcouncil.org/opportunities/travel-grants-fund
    British Council, supported by BFI National Lottery funding in partnership with BFI NETWORK and the BFI International Fund · deadline Rolling / undated · Varies by strand: short and feature film festival grants GBP 150 to 1,500 (typically up to GBP 750); XR travel-only grants GBP 150 to 1,500; large XR grants GBP 1,500 to 5,000; lab grants capped at GBP 6,000; co-production forum grants capped at GBP 2,000. Free to apply.
  • Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst: Project Subsidies 2026-2028 (rolling)
    https://www.amsterdamsfondsvoordekunst.nl/aanvragen/
    Amsterdams Fonds voor de Kunst (AFK) · deadline Rolling / undated · Project grants across four categories, from small awards up to substantial project budgets. Requests up to EUR 7,500 in categories 1 and 2 are scheduled by monthly draw (loting) rather than a queue. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 15 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Sundance Collab x Merrell: Brand-Supported Storytelling Program 2026
    https://collab.sundance.org/catalog/Merrell-Brand-Supported-Storytelling-Program
    Sundance Collab (Sundance Institute) in collaboration with Merrell · deadline Closed 18 Aug 2026 · USD 20,000 production budget per selected filmmaker to make and deliver the greenlit concept, cutdowns (:06, :15, :30) and stills. Includes an online brand-supported storytelling program, and a covered hotel stay for one participant to attend the Sundance Film Festival in January 2027. No application fee.
  • Mondriaan Fund: Inside-Out Art Museum Residency 2027 (Beijing)
    https://www.mondriaanfonds.nl/subsidie-aanvragen/regelingen/residency/inside-out-art-museum-beijing-china/
    Mondriaan Fund / Inside-Out Art Museum · deadline Closed 27 Aug 2026 · Subsidy of EUR 8,478 for an artist or EUR 5,622 for a curator/critic toward travel, material and living costs (a 10 percent personal contribution is automatically deducted by the Mondriaan Fund); studio, living space and Inside-Out Art Museum support are paid directly by the Mondriaan Fund. For a selected duo the total is increased proportionally to cover the second applicant's travel and accommodation. Contribution for Caribbean-based residents can be increased for higher travel costs. No application fee.
  • Gemeente Rotterdam: Project Subsidy Culture (Projectsubsidie Cultuur, September 2026 round)
    https://www.rotterdam.nl/projectsubsidie-cultuur-aanvragen
    Gemeente Rotterdam (Municipality of Rotterdam) · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · No stated per-application cap. Annual pot EUR 1,632,000 split into six rounds of EUR 272,000, with roughly 130 applications per round. Discipline sub-caps: book writing max EUR 4,500; moving image R&D max EUR 4,000; moving-image production max EUR 12,500; post-production max EUR 4,000. Applicants must demonstrably seek other funds or sponsors. Awards over EUR 50,000 require an auditor's statement at reporting, at the applicant's cost. No application fee.
  • Kunstraad Groningen: Two-Year Programme Scheme (Tweejarige Programmaregeling, 2027-2028)
    https://kunstraadgroningen.nl/subsidies/tweejarige-programmaregeling/
    Kunstraad Groningen, on behalf of the municipality and province of Groningen · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · EUR 5,000 minimum to EUR 40,000 maximum per year across two years, so up to EUR 80,000 total. Covers a maximum of one third of total project costs, requiring roughly 67 percent co-financing. Annual scheme budget EUR 325,000. No application fee.
  • Creative Australia: Arts Projects for Organisations (September 2026 round)
    https://creative.gov.au/investments-opportunities/arts-projects-organisations
    Creative Australia · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · AUD 20,000 to 100,000. No matching or co-financing requirement. No application fee. Organisational administrative costs should generally not exceed 10 percent of the total project budget or the application becomes less competitive.
  • KNOWCASE Open Call 2027: permanent digital-culture installation in Madrid (Sonar+D x Fundacion Cotec)
    https://sonar.es/en/news/knowcase-open-call-2027
    Fundacion Cotec and Sonar+D · deadline 07 Sep 2026 · Up to EUR 100,000 (plus VAT), all-inclusive: conceptualisation, design, technical development, production, installation, maintenance, documentation, artist fees, travel, accommodation and insurance.
  • Fonds Podiumkunsten: Foreign Performances or Concerts in the Netherlands (round 4, 2026)
    https://fondspodiumkunsten.nl/subsidies/buitenlandse-voorstellingen-of-concerten-in-nederland
    Fonds Podiumkunsten (Performing Arts Fund NL) · deadline 23 Sep 2026 · Maximum EUR 25,000 per production, capped at EUR 75,000 for an applicant presenting multiple productions. Calculated on travel and transport costs of the foreign artists and their production only. EUR 267,500 available per round shared across this scheme and two sibling internationalisation schemes. Fees, venue and production costs stay with the applicant. No application fee.
  • Gemeente Utrecht: Project Subsidy Culture (Projectsubsidie Cultuur, round 3 2026)
    https://loket.digitaal.utrecht.nl/nl/producten/projectsubsidie-cultuur-aanvragen
    Gemeente Utrecht (Municipality of Utrecht) · deadline 25 Sep 2026 · Category A: EUR 1,000 to 5,000. Category B: EUR 5,000 to 20,000. No fixed co-financing percentage, but a budget and coverage plan is mandatory. eHerkenning purchase costs may be included in the budget and are reimbursed if awarded. No application fee.
  • BNG Cultuurfonds: Project Grants (round closing September 2026)
    https://www.bngbank.nl/bng-cultuurfonds/projectsubsidies
    Stichting BNG Cultuurfonds (BNG Bank) · deadline 27 Sep 2026 · EUR 5,000 minimum to EUR 15,000 maximum. The request must represent 5 to 35 percent of total project funding, so at least 65 percent co-financing is required. The fund is never the sole financier, and place-specific projects require at least one local or regional co-financier. No application fee.
  • Stichting Cultuur Eindhoven: Project Subsidy (Projecten, 2027 round 1)
    https://cultuureindhoven.nl/informatie-over-subsidies-2025-2028/
    Stichting Cultuur Eindhoven · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · Maximum EUR 35,000 per application and maximum 80 percent of eligible costs, so at least 20 percent co-financing is required. No application fee.
  • Ernst von Siemens Musikstiftung: Project Funding (October 2026 round)
    https://evs-musikstiftung.ch/en/project-funding/application/
    Ernst von Siemens Musikstiftung · deadline 01 Oct 2026 · No published minimum or maximum. Primarily covers artistic costs, not overheads. The Foundation explicitly will not fully fund a project, and requires at least one other institution to participate financially at a level similar to the amount requested, functioning as a de facto 1:1 match. No application fee.
  • Gemeente Den Haag: Arts and Culture Projects Category B (autumn 2026 round)
    https://www.denhaag.nl/nl/subsidies/subsidies-cultuur-en-evenementen/subsidie-kunst-en-cultuurprojecten-aanvragen/
    Gemeente Den Haag (Municipality of The Hague) · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · EUR 10,000 to 30,000 per application. The municipal culture-budget contribution may not exceed 30 percent of the total project budget, so at least 70 percent co-financing is required. Annual ceiling for the strand is EUR 600,000. No application fee.
  • Stichting NORMA: NORMA Fonds Project Grant (round 4, 2026)
    https://www.stichtingnorma.nl/norma-fonds/aanvragen/
    Stichting NORMA (collecting society for performing artists) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · Maximum EUR 10,000 per project. Total project budget may not exceed EUR 150,000 and the applicant organisation's annual budget may not exceed EUR 500,000. At least 25 percent of the project budget must come from audience or box-office revenue. Performer fees must meet the 2026 wage norms of EUR 139 per rehearsal and EUR 340 per performance. No application fee.
  • Brabant C: ASML x Brabant C Project Scheme (2026-2027, rolling)
    https://www.brabantc.nl/asml-x-brabant-c-project/
    Brabant C (Provincie Noord-Brabant culture investment fund) in partnership with ASML · deadline Rolling / undated · EUR 25,000 minimum, up to EUR 500,000. Contribution capped at 50 percent of total project budget, so 50 percent co-financing is mandatory. EUR 1.7 million available per year, split evenly between ASML and Brabant C. Requests at or above EUR 50,000 must include a future-viability plan. No application fee.
  • Het Cultuurfonds: Ontwikkelbijdrage for Individual Makers and Collectives (rolling, Netherlands)
    https://www.cultuurfonds.nl/aanvragen/individuele-aanvragen
    Het Cultuurfonds (formerly Prins Bernhard Cultuurfonds), via voordekunst · deadline Rolling / undated · Ontwikkelbijdrage (development contribution) up to EUR 5,000, awarded once every three years. A separate matchfundingbijdrage of EUR 250 to EUR 1,500 (max 50 percent of the crowdfunding target) is available once a year for public-facing projects. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 8 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Inlaks Shivdasani Foundation: Inlaks Theatre Art Award 2027
    https://www.inlaksfoundation.org/
    Inlaks Shivdasani Foundation · deadline Closed 15 Aug 2026 · INR 15,000 per month for up to 12 months, around INR 180,000 total (roughly USD 2,050 / EUR 1,780). No application fee.
  • transmediale x Pro Helvetia Digital Art Residency 2027
    https://transmediale.de/en/news/digital-art-residency-2027
    transmediale (in cooperation with the Swiss Arts Council Pro Helvetia) · deadline Closed 28 Aug 2026 · Artist fee of CHF 2,000 per month across the two-month residency (CHF 4,000), plus a production grant of CHF 15,000 for the selected project, plus travel and accommodation for both the festival and the residency month. Duos and collectives may apply but the fee and the production grant stay the same and must be shared. No application fee.
  • Andy Warhol Foundation: Exhibition Support (Fall 2026 round)
    https://warholfoundation.org/grants/application-guidelines/exhibition-support/
    The Andy Warhol Foundation for the Visual Arts · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · USD 60,000 to 100,000. Direct costs only (artist payments, catalogue and publication, artist-designed public programmes); staff salaries excluded. Request must not exceed 25 percent of total direct project costs, which functions as a de facto 75 percent co-financing requirement. No application fee.
  • Andy Warhol Foundation: Multi-year Program Support (Fall 2026 round)
    https://warholfoundation.org/grants/application-guidelines/multi-year-program-support/
    The Andy Warhol Foundation for the Visual Arts · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · USD 60,000 to 100,000 across two years. Request must not exceed 25 percent of the organisation's annual operating budget. No formal match, but the 25 percent cap means the balance must come from elsewhere. No application fee.
  • Andy Warhol Foundation: Project Grants for Small-Scale Organizations (Fall 2026 round)
    https://warholfoundation.org/grants/application-guidelines/project-grants-for-small-scale-organizations/
    The Andy Warhol Foundation for the Visual Arts · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · USD 20,000 to 30,000 toward direct costs such as artist payments and production. No application fee.
  • Berlin Senate: Arbeitsstipendium Bildende Kunst 2027 (Berlin residents only)
    https://www.berlin.de/sen/kultur/en/funding/funding-programmes/visual-arts/artikel.230092.en.php
    Berlin Senate Department for Culture and Social Cohesion · deadline Closed 02 Sep 2026 · EUR 16,000 (8 months) or EUR 24,000 (12 months), paid as EUR 2,000 per month. No application fee.
  • Berlin Senate: Arbeitsstipendien Film/Video 2027, Kuenstlerinnenfoerderung (Berlin-based women artists)
    https://www.berlin.de/sen/kultur/foerderung/antragsfristen/
    Berlin Senate Department for Culture and Social Cohesion · deadline 01 Oct 2026 · Work stipend for women film and video artists; the amount for this round is not yet confirmed (sibling Senate work stipends pay EUR 2,000 per month). No application fee.
  • Pandora Short Film Grant 2026
    https://pandora.org/
    Pandora Short Film Grant · deadline 01 Oct 2026 · $12,000 production grant to the winner, plus a Panavision camera package (worth about $15,000), an optional $1,000 Kodak Film Grant toward film stock and lab expenses, mentorship from an award-winning filmmaker, and fiscal sponsorship. Three finalists receive mentorship, fiscal sponsorship, consideration for the Panavision New Filmmaker Program, and $500 off Athos production insurance. ENTRY FEE: tiered, $30 regular ($27 Gold members) and $40 late ($36); Pandora states fee waivers are available on request.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 10 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 27 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Inlaks Shivdasani Foundation: Inlaks Fine Art Award 2027
    https://inlaksfoundation.submittable.com/submit/75e14093-df9b-41c5-af96-ce2360e64e1b/the-inlaks-fine-art-award-2027
    Inlaks Shivdasani Foundation · deadline Closed 15 Aug 2026 · INR 300,000 (around USD 3,400 / EUR 2,950) for one year, plus a fully covered four-week art residency at an Indian art institution. No application fee.
  • Focus Photo (Visual Arts)
    https://prohelvetia.ch/en/find-support/focus-photo
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · Maximum grant of CHF 25,000 toward the production. No application fee.
  • Production Grant (Visual Arts)
    https://prohelvetia.ch/en/find-support/production-grant
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · Maximum CHF 25,000. No application fee.
  • Grant for Production with Presentation (Visual Arts)
    https://prohelvetia.ch/en/find-support/grant-for-production-with-presentation
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · Maximum CHF 25,000. No application fee.
  • In Listening 2027: Call for Hybrid Radio/Live Works (CTM Festival, Berlin)
    https://www.ctm-festival.de/festival-2027/open-calls/in-listening-2027
    CTM Festival with Deutschlandfunk Kultur and ORF · deadline 06 Sep 2026 · Two selected works are each supported by a fee of EUR 6,000. CTM covers travel to Berlin and lodging during the production and festival periods; technical and staging costs for the CTM presentation (and possible ORF musikprotokoll presentation) are covered separately by arrangement. Research, creation and collaborator costs are the artist's own. Radio-production support (translations, voiceovers, studio time) can be provided by Deutschlandfunk Kultur upon discussion. No application fee.
  • BFI National Lottery Creative Challenge Fund (Round Two)
    https://www.bfi.org.uk/get-funding-support/create-films-tv-or-new-formats-storytelling/bfi-national-lottery-creative-challenge-fund
    British Film Institute (BFI National Lottery) · deadline 21 Sep 2026 · Award amounts are not published on the fund page. No application fee.
  • BFI National Lottery Impact Feature Funding (Higher-Budget Features)
    https://www.bfi.org.uk/get-funding-support/create-films-tv-or-new-formats-storytelling/bfi-filmmaking-fund-discovery-impact-feature-funding
    British Film Institute (BFI Filmmaking Fund, National Lottery) · deadline Rolling / undated · Up to GBP 1,250,000, the largest single award in the current BFI portfolio, though the BFI notes it does not expect to support many projects at the maximum level. Production budgets from GBP 1M to GBP 15M for experienced directors, GBP 3.5M to GBP 15M for debut directors. No application fee.
  • BFI National Lottery Development Funding (Feature Script and Package Development)
    https://www.bfi.org.uk/get-funding-support/create-films-tv-or-new-formats-storytelling/development-funding
    British Film Institute (BFI Filmmaking Fund, National Lottery) · deadline Rolling / undated · Award amounts are not published on the fund page. No application fee.
  • BFI National Lottery Audience Projects Fund
    https://www.bfi.org.uk/get-funding-support/bring-film-wider-audience/bfi-national-lottery-audience-projects-fund
    British Film Institute (BFI National Lottery) · deadline Rolling / undated · Pilot projects GBP 10,000 to GBP 20,000. Standard projects GBP 20,000 to GBP 500,000 per year. Immersive projects may include up to GBP 150,000 of production costs within the GBP 500,000 cap. Total fund GBP 19.7M over three years. No application fee.
  • BFI National Lottery Screen Heritage Fund: Individual Skills Funding
    https://www.bfi.org.uk/get-funding-support/bfi-national-lottery-screen-heritage-fund-project-resilience-skills-funding
    British Film Institute (BFI National Lottery Screen Heritage Fund) · deadline Rolling / undated · Award amounts are not published on the fund page. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 3 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 20 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Cafe Royal Cultural Foundation: Performance Grant (Summer 2026)
    https://caferoyalculturalfoundation.org/performance-page
    Cafe Royal Cultural Foundation NYC · deadline Closed 03 Aug 2026 · Up to $10,000 for production costs (performers, collaborators, rehearsal and venue rental, design elements, technical staff, etc.). Does not fund the creation or composition of new work. No application fee.
  • BFI National Lottery Discovery Feature Funding (Debut Fiction Features)
    https://www.bfi.org.uk/get-funding-support/create-films-tv-or-new-formats-storytelling/bfi-filmmaking-fund-discovery-impact-feature-funding
    British Film Institute (BFI Filmmaking Fund, National Lottery) · deadline Closed 13 Aug 2026 · Up to GBP 1,000,000 of National Lottery funding towards a fiction feature with a production budget between GBP 1,000,000 and GBP 3,500,000. No application fee.
  • FUJIFILM GFX Challenge Grant Program 2026
    https://www.fujifilm-x.com/global/gfx-challenge-grant-program/year-2026/
    FUJIFILM · deadline Closed 17 Aug 2026 · 5 Global Grant Awards of USD 10,000 and 10 Regional Grant Awards of USD 5,000. All recipients also get complimentary use of a GFX System camera body (including the FUJIFILM GFX ETERNA 55 filmmaking camera) and two GF lenses for the duration of the project, plus mentoring and technical assistance from Fujifilm technicians and product experts. Total approximate retail value of all awards: USD 229,500. No purchase necessary; no entry fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 9 new Media Arts, Film & Sound grants - week of 13 Jul 2026
item.description:
• A.R.M. Holding / Art Dubai Projects: H Residence Sculpture Park Commission (Dubai)
    https://www.artdubai.ae/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/ADP_ARM-HOLDING-COMMISSION_OPEN-CALL-PACK-.pdf
    A.R.M. Holding / HUNA / Art Dubai Projects · deadline Closed 25 Jul 2026 · AED 1,000,000 commission envelope, inclusive of artist fee, design development, fabrication, materials, production, transport, installation, lighting and finishing. Proposal fees are available for shortlisted artists. No submission fee.
  • Modern Art Oxford: Collaborative Micro-commissions Open Call 2026
    https://modernartoxford.org.uk/blog/open-call-2026
    Modern Art Oxford · deadline Closed 26 Jul 2026 · GBP 1,000 artist fee per selected collective, plus up to GBP 500 production budget, curatorial mentorship from the Modern Art Oxford team, four months of public exhibition display, professional installation photography, promotion, technical and production support, artwork transport support within the South East, peer networking, and inclusion in a public preview event. No application fee.
  • Fundacion Camila Caneque: International Residency Programme 2026
    https://www.fundacioncamilacaneque.org/agenda/programa-internacional-de-residencia-2026/
    Fundacion Camila Caneque with BAR project · deadline Closed 31 Jul 2026 · EUR 2,000 gross stipend, plus accommodation, meals, utilities, round-trip travel, insurance, and curatorial support. 6 weeks. No application fee.
  • Corridor: DAISY CHAIN Artist Commission (Adur, West Sussex)
    https://www.corridorprojects.org.uk/daisy-chain-commission
    Corridor Projects · deadline Closed 03 Aug 2026 · GBP 4,200 artist fee (inclusive of VAT) paid in instalments, plus travel, and an additional budget for materials for creative production, workshops and exhibition outputs (e.g. print). No application fee.
